title: Artifact Gateway and Profiling Orchestrator for Community Model Intake
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an end-to-end gateway and orchestrator that automates safe intake, hermetic conversion, validation, and canonical profiling of community model weights. This ticket scopes the staging gateway that receives artifacts (HF tarballs, S3 manifests), applies provenance checks and fingerprinting, runs a deterministic conversion container (ONNX/optimized checkpoint -> runtime artifacts including quantized candidates), and then executes a profiling harness that produces a publishable performance profile (latency distribution, memory, token throughput, quality smoke tests). The orchestrator must emit a pin manifest (model id + digest + conversion recipe + profile id) suitable for downstream rollout automation and the model catalog. The flow should support manual review gating, automatic low-risk publish for small models, and a canary rollout for heavy-weight models.
acceptance_criteria: Gateway receives an artifact and verifies source provenance (HF model card URL or signed S3 manifest) and computes a layerwise fingerprint
Hermetic conversion runs in a reproducible container and produces runtime artifacts and optional quantized variants with deterministic metadata
Profiling harness runs standardized workloads and emits a performance profile in schema v2 (latency P50/P90/P99, memory peak, tokens/sec, smoke eval accuracy)
A pin manifest is generated containing model version, digest, conversion recipe, recommended default variant, and profile id and is stored in the model registry
Operator UI in Console shows staging item with provenance, conversion logs, profile summary, and approve/reject buttons
Automated tests: end-to-end pipeline integration test added, and CI verifies conversion container SHA and profile schema compatibility
Security review completed and KMS signing enabled for production pin manifests
tasks: Design gateway API endpoints and artifact schema (POST /intake with manifest) - design doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ONB/Artifact+Gateway+Spec
Implement provenance verifier (HF URL whitelist, manifest signature verification)
Create hermetic conversion container with pinned dependencies and deterministic build (Dockerfile + build pipeline)
Implement profiling harness (trace collector, token distribution sampler, small quality evals)
Schema v2 for performance profile and generator library
Pin manifest generator and model-registry integration
Console staging UI and operator actions (approve/reject, re-run conversion)
CI integration and end-to-end test harness
Run security review and add KMS signing step for manifest publication
notes: Design decisions: prefer deterministic conversion containers over runtime-transformation to ensure reproducibility and easier rollback. See design doc above for trade-offs.
Conversions will emit both 'native' runtime artifacts and a metadata-only lightweight descriptor for quick compatibility checks.
Profiling harness uses a small prompt set (~200 short prompts) representative of production workloads; we'll extend with customer-specific prompt packs later.

Quantization candidates: we generate 8-bit and 4-bit candidate artifacts but only publish 'recommended' variant in pin manifest. Auto-quantize will be disabled for models flagged by license/quality checks.
We will leverage existing admission heuristics from ENG-20714 for initial vetting and fall back to manual review if checks fail.
Edge-case: very large models (>40B) will land in 'heavy' queue and go through a canary + staged publish (longer profiling runs).
